headline: 5 Solana program/key addresses catalogued from docs and GitHub; on-chain reads blocked (Solana not supported by DeFiPunkd API); both audit PDFs login-gated.

findings.text: D1: Solana has no Etherscan-style name-tag search endpoint. Searched Solscan (solscan.io) and SolanaFM (solana.fm) via web search for vault program address 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi; both surfaced account pages confirming the address exists on-chain but returned no additional tagged contracts or multisig addresses.

D2: Official developer docs at docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/dynamic-vault list the vault program ID (24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi, same on mainnet and devnet), affiliate vault program (GacY9YuN16HNRTy7ZWwULPccwvfFSBeNLuAQP7y38Du3), treasury address (9kZeN47U2dubGbbzMrzzoRAUvpuxVLRcjW9XiFpYjUo4), and VAULT_BASE_KEY (HWzXGcGHy4tcpYfaRDCyLNzXqBTv3E6BttpCH2vJxArv). No separate deployed-contracts page was found; this developer guide is the canonical address reference.

D3: Both audit PDFs linked in protocol.audit_links are hosted on Google Drive and require login to access. PDF title metadata only was retrieved: audit 1 is 'Mercurial Finance - Final Report.pdf'; audit 2 is 'Mercurial_Finance_Vault_Dynamic_AMM_Solana_Program_Security_Audit.pdf'. No in-scope address table could be extracted. Audit firms and dates unknown from this run.

D4: GitHub repo MeteoraAg/vault-sdk confirmed at github.com/MeteoraAg/vault-sdk. README confirms vault program ID 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi. Docs reference source repo MeteoraAg/mercurial-vault at github.com/MeteoraAg/mercurial-vault/tree/main/programs/vault, but this URL was not directly fetched (not in prior allowlist). No Foundry broadcast or hardhat-deploy artifacts were found in vault-sdk (Anchor/Solana project, not EVM). Anchor.toml and Cargo.toml are present in vault-sdk but their content was not fetched.
D5: Protocol is Solana-only (single chain). D1-D4 were applied to Solana. No multi-chain enumeration needed.

D6: Docs confirm that Dynamic Vaults are PDA-derived per token mint (one vault per mint, not a factory with enumerable children via a view method). The DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana (supported chainIds are 1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111). Factory-child enumeration via /api/contract/read is impossible for this protocol.
D7: Role taxonomy applied: vault program (program/other), affiliate vault program (other), treasury address (treasury/unknown actor class), VAULT_BASE_KEY PDA base (other). All from docs evidence.
D8: All 5 addresses in admin_addresses trace to the fetched docs URL (docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/dynamic-vault). No address appears only in a snippet.

rationale.verdict: Discovery walk covered: (1) Meteora docs developer guide (fetched), (2) GitHub MeteoraAg/vault-sdk (fetched), (3) audit PDFs (login-gated, titles only), (4) Solscan/SolanaFM explorer pages (search snippets only). 5 Solana program/key addresses catalogued. DeFiPunkd API cannot read Solana state; all evidence is off-chain. grade=unknown because on-chain reads are structurally impossible for Solana via DeFiPunkd, both audit reports are inaccessible, and the mercurial-vault source repo was not directly fetched.

unknowns: D1: Solana block explorers (Solscan, SolanaFM, Solana Explorer) do not support EVM-style name-tag search endpoints (e.g. Etherscan searchHandler); no additional tagged protocol contracts surfaced beyond vault program address.

D3: Both audit PDFs (drive.google.com IDs 1CjdMl7LhJisnI1LTrAFt2Bvi5ahqq1yc and 1cJ2ZH23yj9uO1otR2pLDQ1MP3OJm84IW) require Google login; audit firm names, audit dates, and in-scope address tables are unknown this run.

D4: Source repo MeteoraAg/mercurial-vault (linked from docs as canonical vault program source) was not directly fetched; commit SHA, Anchor.toml program IDs, and any broadcast deployment artifacts are unknown.

D6: DeFiPunkd /api/contract/read endpoint does not support Solana; per-mint vault PDA addresses cannot be enumerated via read API. On-chain reads for all Solana addresses are blocked this run - offchain.

D8: VAULT_BASE_KEY (HWzXGcGHy4tcpYfaRDCyLNzXqBTv3E6BttpCH2vJxArv) and treasury address (9kZeN47U2dubGbbzMrzzoRAUvpuxVLRcjW9XiFpYjUo4) actor classes are unknown; no on-chain bytecode or account type read was possible.

protocol_metadata.about: Meteora Dynamic Vaults (formerly Mercurial Finance) is a yield aggregator on Solana where users deposit supported SPL tokens, receive vault LP tokens representing their share, and earn optimized yield sourced from multiple Solana lending protocols. The vault program (ID: 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi) allocates capital across up to 30 configurable strategies, with a 5% performance fee minted as LP tokens on each profitable rebalance. Integrators and AMM pools (including Meteora's own DAMM v1) use the vaults as composable yield-bearing reserve accounts, accessed via a TypeScript SDK and Rust client.
